 Console is back on LCD

08 Sep '04 - + 6 - 1 Console is back on LCD

As you can see, console is back on framebuffer. The updated framebuffer sourcecode and the new bootlogo are in CVS. If you want to try it yourself, download http://www.linux4.be/2004/linux4be20040908.zip(it's the latest loader, kernel with new ramdisk and config).
